questions.question:
Arrange the following words in a logical and meaningful order 

1. Colonel

2. Field Marshal

3. Brigadier

4. Lieutenant 

5. General

2. Field Marshal

5. General

3. Brigadier

1. Colonel

4. Lieutenant

Hence, 2, 5, 3, 1, 4 is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers in the given set

(8, 7, 407)
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is,

(Second number) ³ + (first number) ² = third number

Like,

(7)³ + (8)² = 343 + 64 = 407

Similarly

**(6)³ + (9)² = 216 + 81 = 297 = 297**

Hence, (9, 6, 297) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if the appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follows(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. No bottle is a pen

2. All jugs are bottles.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some jugs are pens.

II. No jug is pen

III. Some bottles are jugs.

options.text: Either conclusion I or II follows.
Conclusion III and either conclusion I or II follow.
All conclusions I, II and III follow.
Only conclusions II and III follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is as follows,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/627d417fbc2723678d237223c27d330ec4c1251de6c00f230821555b7f469d1c.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some jugs are pens → False (All jugs are bottles and No bottle is a pen)

II. No jug is pen → True(All jugs are bottles and No bottle is a pen)

III. Some bottles are jugs → True (All jugs are bottles)

Hence, only conclusions II and III follow.

questions.question: In a class of 100 students, every student has passed in one or more of the three subjects, i.e History, Economics and English. Among all the student, 24 students have passed in English only, 14 students have passed in History only 11 students have passed in both English and Economics only, and 12 students have passed in both English and History only. A total of 50 students have passed in History. If only 5 students have passed in all three subjects, then how many students have passed in Economies only?
questions.solution:
Total no. of students in the class = 100

No. of students passed in English only = 24

No. of students passed in History only = 14

No. of students passed in both English and Economics only = 11

No. of students passed in both English and History only = 12

No. of students passed in History = 50

No. of students passed in all three subjects = 5

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d51b8d7a5e8ebd2d2e902b7830d7bc5c4e847611e44cecf1681373d95810b270.png] 

No. of students who passed in Economics only = 100 - (50 + 24 + 11) = 100 - 85 = 15.

Hence, 15 is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Which two signs and two numbers should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

28 – 32 ÷ 2 × 8 + 34 = 132
questions.solution:
Given equation: 28 – 32 ÷ 2 × 8 + 34 = 132

1) × and -; 32 and 34

Interchanging according to the option

 28 × 34 ÷ 2 – 8 + 32

= 28 × 17 – 8 + 32

= 476 – 8 + 32

= 508 – 8

= 500 ≠ 132

**2) + AND -; 32 and 34**

**Interchanging according to the option**

**28 + 34 ÷ 2 × 8 – 32**

**= 28 + 17 × 8 – 32**

**= 28 + 136 – 32 **

**= 164 – 32 **

**= 132**

3) + and -; 28 and 32

Interchanging according to the option

32 + 28 ÷ 2 × 8 – 34

= 32 + 14 × 8 – 34

= 32 + 112 – 34

= 144 – 34

= 110 ≠ 132

4) × and -; 8 and 2

Interchanging according to the option

28 × 32 ÷ 8 – 2 + 34

= 28 × 4 – 2 + 34

= 112 – 2 + 34

= 146 – 2

= 144 ≠ 132

Hence, + AND -; 32 and 34 is the correct answer

questions.question: Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it. 42 37
questions.solution:
The logic follows here is:-

42 × 18 ÷ 3

= 42 × 6 = 252,

37 × 24 ÷ 3

= 37 × 8 = 296,

Similarly,

45 × 36 ÷ 3

= 45 × 12 = 540.

Hence, 45 is the answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number. 

13 : 109 :: 24 : ?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is second number = (first number × 8) + 5

109 = (13 × 8) + 5 = 104 + 5 = 109

Similarly,

? = (24 × 8) + 5 = 192 + 5 = 197

? = 197

Hence, 197 is the correct answer.

options.text: P is paternal uncle of R

questions.solution:
From the above given information,

P – K means P is brother of K

K × Y means K is father of Y

Y – J means Y is brother of J

J ÷ S means J is daughter of S

S + R means S is mother of R

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f18e6164680328dfe75943070bda3c0887f40d3ef9b07f44029fcd20b7c57272.png] 

The family tree diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e631267d0f7193552b71aa8e9e99a2d53a85a00ccbcf1feada65f26cb23d0b7c.png] 

Therefore, J is not the daughter of P.

Hence, ‘J is daughter of P’ is the incorrect statement.
